name: ne503-aipc-sdk
description: C++ SDK for the NeoRuntime AI platform (inference, media, device/camera control, events, audio).

dependencies.name: grpc
dependencies.$comment: Host-triplet gRPC provides protoc + grpc_cpp_plugin for cross-compile codegen

dependencies.name: opencv4
dependencies.$comment: Headless: client SDK only needs cv::Mat (core), cv::cvtColor (imgproc), cv::imwrite (imgcodecs) + codecs. Disabling default features drops gtk/highgui/cairo/dnn/v4l — the whole GUI stack, which also dodges a known cairo arm64 cross-compile failure.
